d:
Mokama ke purv vidhayak anant sinh ki beti ki shadi men jadyu ke adhikansh bare netaon ne duri banae rakhi. lalan sinh ko chhorkar parti ke any pramukh chehre is aayojan men najar nahin aae. rajnitik halkon men netaon ki is gair-maujudgi ko lekar tarah-tarah ki charchaen aur kayas lagae ja rahe hain.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
